title: scrophularia ebulifolia var. schousboei
intro: Scrophularia ebulifolia var. schousboei, commonly known as the Autumn Skullcap, is a plant species within the Scrophulariaceae family. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial and antiviral activities. The bioactive constituents of Scrophularia ebulifolia var. schousboei include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
